subject: reasoning
question:
A dice has its faces marked by letters R, S, T, U, V and W. Two positions of the same dice are shown below. Which face is opposite to face R? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2390aea910344f6c79bd1aa42eabe13f816212feafc67184ce286531224ce786.png]
solution:
Logic: If two dice have the same face value in the given image then their clockwise or anticlockwise wise number are known as opposite numbers in dice.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/176a9b0cacf2525e2fb13ab780ed5abfb002512eee7d70df2f03b393b14448c9.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2945514f113c50ed1e6429606ab08cb227eb0debd286c7ebab74ea30e60796aa.png] 

The opposite sides of the dice are given as above.

The remaining face in the given question figure is R. 

Therefore, the opposite side to R is W. 

Hence. the correct answer is "**Option 2**".
